chain_words.nuance: pleasing to look at, but without great depth
charming and warm in appearance or character
so striking that it takes one's breath away
beauty so great that it inspires awe and seems almost transcendent

explanation: These words all describe beauty, from a pleasant appearance to an almost awe-inspiring splendour.

usage_notes.difference: 'Beautiful' describes a general quality of beauty; 'stunning' suggests a sudden and striking impression that surprises the viewer.
